title: Raids in Europe over alleged far-right embezzlement: EU prosecutors
summary: EU prosecutors said Tuesday they were conducting searches in France and other countries into alleged misappropriation of EU funds by a defunct far-right group in the European parliament, Identity and Democracy. contentText: EU prosecutors said Tuesday they were conducting searches in France and other countries into alleged misappropriation of EU funds by a defunct far-right group in the European parliament, Identity and Democracy. The ID group contained MEPs from a range of Eurosceptic parties including France's National Rally (RN), Italy's League and the Alternative for Germany. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating reports from Dublin.
